story_title: Lehi Prays in Behalf of His People and Sees a Pillar of Fire
story_summary: Warned by prophets of Jerusalem’s destruction, Lehi prays with all his heart in behalf of his people, beholds the heavens opened and the Savior descending, and departs into the wilderness to keep the Lord’s commandments.

story_title: Nephi Softens His Heart and Seeks the Lord’s Witness
story_summary: Being exceedingly young yet having great desires to know the mysteries of God, Nephi cries unto the Lord in faith until his heart is softened and he believes all the words of his father.

story_title: Nephi Covenants to Go and Do What the Lord Commands
story_summary: When commanded to return to Jerusalem for the plates of brass, Laman and Lemuel murmur, but Nephi declares his unwavering faith that the Lord prepares a way for those who keep His commandments.

story_title: Nephi Is Led by the Spirit to Obtain the Brass Plates
story_summary: After two failed attempts to obtain the plates from Laban, Nephi walks into Jerusalem by night trusting completely in the Spirit, not knowing beforehand the things which he should do.

story_title: Zoram Makes an Oath and Covenant to Tarry with Lehi’s Family
story_summary: Mistaking Nephi for Laban until they reach the wilderness, Zoram takes courage at Nephi’s words and enters into a solemn oath and covenant to remain faithful with Lehi’s family in freedom.

story_title: Sariah’s Faith Is Confirmed When Her Sons Return Safely
story_summary: Having mourned in the wilderness fearing her sons had perished, Sariah rejoices when they return with the brass plates and testifies that the Lord had truly commanded her husband to flee.

story_title: Nephi Forgives His Brethren and Their Bands Are Loosed
story_summary: Bound with cords in the wilderness by his angry brothers, Nephi prays in faith to the Lord, who bursts the bands from his hands and feet, and Nephi frankly forgives his repentant brethren.

story_title: Lehi Partakes of the Tree of Life by Holding to the Rod
story_summary: Lost in a dark and dreary waste, Lehi prays unto the Lord for mercy, is led to the tree whose fruit fills his soul with exceeding joy, and beckons his family to hold fast to the rod of iron.

story_title: Nephi Desires to See and Know the Things His Father Saw
story_summary: Believing that the Lord is able to make all things known to those who diligently seek Him, Nephi ponders in his heart and is caught away by the Spirit to behold the condescension of the Son of God.

story_title: The Liahona Works According to Faith and Diligence
story_summary: Outside his tent door, Lehi discovers a miraculous brass compass prepared by the Lord that points the way through the wilderness strictly according to the family’s faith, heed, and diligence.

story_title: Nephi Makes a New Bow and Asks Where to Go for Food
story_summary: When his fine steel bow breaks and his family suffers for want of food, Nephi refuses to murmur, fashions a wooden bow, and humbly asks his chastened father to inquire of the Lord.

story_title: Nephi Builds a Ship by Divine Instruction in Bountiful
story_summary: Commanded to construct a vessel after the manner shown by the Lord rather than after the manner of men, Nephi prays frequently on the mount and trusts that God can accomplish all things.

story_title: Nephi Praises the Lord During the Tempest on the Deep
story_summary: Tied with cords for four days during a terrible storm while his brothers rebel, Nephi looks to his God and praises Him all the day long until his brothers repent and the sea is calmed.

story_title: Jacob’s Unshaken Faith Confronts Sherem
story_summary: When Sherem seeks to overthrow the doctrine of Christ, Jacob relies on the Spirit and previous witness of angels, and the power of God brings Sherem to confess Christ before the multitude.

story_title: Enos Wrestles Before God in Mighty Prayer
story_summary: Remembering his father’s words concerning eternal life, Enos cries unto his Maker in mighty prayer all day and into the night until he hears the Lord’s voice forgiving his sins through faith in Christ.

story_title: King Benjamin’s People Cry for Mercy and Enter a Covenant
story_summary: Humbled to the dust by King Benjamin’s testimony of the Savior, the people cry with one voice for the atoning blood of Christ to be applied and covenant to do the will of the Lord.

story_title: Abinadi Seals His Testimony of Christ Before King Noah
story_summary: Standing bound before a wicked king and his priests, Abinadi refuses to recall his testimony of the Redeemer’s atoning sacrifice and courageously seals his witness with his life.

story_title: Alma Repents and Enters the Covenant at the Waters of Mormon
story_summary: Believing the words of Abinadi, Alma repents of his sins, teaches the people privately, and invites them to enter the fold of God by baptism as a witness of their covenant to bear one another’s burdens.

story_title: Limhi’s People Humble Themselves and Turn to the Lord
story_summary: Brought into heavy bondage because of their iniquities, the people of Limhi humble themselves to the depths of humility and cry mightily to God until He begins to soften their captors’ hearts.

story_title: The Lord Makes the Burdens of Alma’s People Light
story_summary: Forbidden even to pray vocally by taskmasters, Alma and his covenant people pour out their hearts to God, who strengthens them so they bear their burdens with ease until their deliverance.

story_title: Alma the Younger and the Sons of Mosiah Are Converted
story_summary: Struck dumb by an angel while seeking to destroy the Church, Alma the Younger repents through three days of torment after his father fasts and prays in faith that he will come to a knowledge of the truth.

story_title: Alma the Younger Calls on Jesus Christ for Mercy
story_summary: Recounting his conversion to his son Helaman, Alma describes how remembering his father’s prophecy of Jesus Christ led him to cry out in his heart for mercy, filling his soul with light and joy.

story_title: Amulek Opens His Heart and Home to the Prophet Alma
story_summary: Having once hardened his heart though called many times, Amulek obeys the voice of an angel, receives Alma into his home, and forsakes worldly riches to testify of the coming Redeemer.

story_title: Zeezrom Trembles Under Conviction and Is Healed by Faith
story_summary: Confounded by the words of Alma and Amulek, Zeezrom confesses his guilt, lies burning with a fever of torment, and leaps to his feet whole when he professes faith in the power of Christ.

story_title: Alma and Amulek Break Their Bonds as Prison Walls Fall
story_summary: After enduring days of mockery and hunger in the prison of Ammonihah, Alma cries unto the Lord for strength according to their faith in Christ, and their cords burst as the prison walls fall.

story_title: Ammon Serves King Lamoni and Defends the Flocks
story_summary: Entering the land of Ishmael after fasting and prayer, Ammon pledges to be King Lamoni’s servant, wins the hearts of his fellow servants by miraculous courage, and opens the door to preach the gospel.

story_title: King Lamoni and His Queen Arise Born of the Spirit
story_summary: Overcome by the Spirit while pondering the plan of redemption, King Lamoni and his believing queen wake to testify that they have seen their Redeemer and that He has redeemed their souls.

story_title: Abish Gathers the Multitude and Raises the Queen by the Hand
story_summary: Having been converted unto the Lord for many years because of a remarkable vision of her father, the servant Abish seizes the opportunity to call the people together and takes the queen by the hand.

story_title: King Lamoni’s Father Offers to Give Away All His Sins
story_summary: When Aaron expounds the scriptures from the Creation to the Atonement of Christ, the great king of the Lamanites prostrates himself and cries out that he will give away all his sins to know God.

story_title: The Anti-Nephi-Lehies Bury Their Weapons of Rebellion
story_summary: Converted unto the Lord and cleansed through the merits of His Son, the people of Anti-Nephi-Lehi make a solemn covenant with God never to shed blood again, burying their swords deep in the earth.

story_title: The Anti-Nephi-Lehies Kneel in Prayer and Convert Their Attackers
story_summary: Refusing to break their covenant even in the face of death, the people of Ammon prostrate themselves in prayer while attacked, moving more than a thousand Lamanites to repent and join them.

story_title: Alma Teaches the Zoramites to Plant the Word in Their Hearts
story_summary: Cast out of their synagogues because of their coarse apparel, the poor among the Zoramites learn from Alma that they can worship God anywhere and nourish the seed of faith into a tree of life.

story_title: Corianton Is Called to Repentance and Restored to the Ministry
story_summary: After forsaking the ministry to follow after the harlot Isabel, Corianton is lovingly taught the doctrine of Christ’s justice and mercy by his father Alma, repents, and returns to preach the word.

story_title: Captain Moroni Raises the Title of Liberty
story_summary: Renting his coat to write a sacred reminder of their religion, peace, and families, Moroni calls the Nephites to enter into a covenant to keep God’s commandments or their garments shall be rent.

story_title: Moroni’s Army Prays and Spare Their Repentant Enemies
story_summary: Surrounded by Zarahemnah’s forces, Moroni’s soldiers cry unto the Lord for liberty, prevail by faith, and immediately cease shedding blood as soon as their enemies covenant to keep the peace.

story_title: Helaman’s Two Thousand Stripling Warriors Trust Their Mothers’ Faith
story_summary: Taking up arms so their fathers will not break their covenant, two thousand young men fight with miraculous strength and not one soul perishes because they do not doubt their mothers knew God would deliver them.

story_title: Helaman’s Army Pours Out Their Souls in Prayer for Strength
story_summary: Receiving neither provisions nor reinforcements while facing a superior army, Helaman and his men pour out their souls in prayer, and the Lord fills them with peace and unshakable faith.

story_title: Nephi and Lehi Are Encircled by a Pillar of Fire in Prison
story_summary: Cast into the same prison where Ammon’s brethren once lay, Nephi and Lehi stand fearless as a cloud of darkness overshadows their captors, who repent at Aminadab’s counsel to have faith in Christ.

story_title: Nephi Receives the Sealing Power Because of Unwearying Faith
story_summary: Pondering in his heart over the wickedness of the people, Nephi is commended by the voice of the Lord for declaring His word with unwearyingness and is given power to seal on earth and in heaven.

story_title: Nephi Prays That the Famine May Replace the Sword
story_summary: Seeking to save his people from destruction by war, Nephi asks the Lord to send a famine to stir them to remembrance, and when they humble themselves and repent, the Lord sends rain at Nephi’s prayer.

story_title: Samuel the Lamanite Testifies from the Wall of Zarahemla
story_summary: Cast out by the people of Zarahemla, Samuel returns at the voice of the Lord to climb the city wall, protected by the power of God from stones and arrows while calling the people to faith and repentance.

story_title: Nephi Prays All Day Until the Sign of Christ’s Birth Appears
story_summary: When unbelievers set a day to put the faithful to death if the sign of the Savior’s birth does not come, Nephi bows to the earth in mighty prayer all day until the voice of Christ proclaims the sign.

story_title: The Multitude at Bountiful Thrust Their Hands into the Savior’s Side
story_summary: Descending from heaven to the temple in Bountiful, the risen Jesus Christ invites the multitude one by one to feel the prints of the nails in His hands and feet, and they fall at His feet in worship.

story_title: The Risen Savior Heals the Sick and Blesses the Little Children
story_summary: Perceiving that the multitude’s faith is sufficient that He should heal them, Jesus heals every afflicted soul, weeps for joy, and prays to the Father as angels encircle their little ones with fire.

story_title: The Brother of Jared’s Faith Pierces the Veil on Mount Shelem
story_summary: Bringing sixteen molten stones to the mount and asking the Lord to touch them so the barges will have light, the Brother of Jared sees the finger of the Lord and beholds the premortal Redeemer.

story_title: Zacharias and Elisabeth Trust the Lord’s Promise of John’s Birth
story_summary: After walking blamelessly in all the commandments of the Lord, Zacharias and Elisabeth rejoice as the angel’s promise is fulfilled and Zacharias’s tongue is loosed to prophesy of the Redeemer.

story_title: Mary Humbly Accepts Her Calling as Mother of the Son of God
story_summary: Visited by the angel Gabriel in Nazareth, Mary responds to the miraculous announcement of the Savior’s birth with complete faith and submission: “Be it unto me according to thy word.”

story_title: Joseph Obeys the Angel’s Voice to Take Mary as His Wife
story_summary: While pondering privately how to spare Mary shame, Joseph is instructed in a dream by an angel of the Lord and immediately obeys in faith, naming the child Jesus.

story_title: Simeon and Anna Behold the Infant Redeemer in the Temple
story_summary: Having waited faithfully for the consolation of Israel, Simeon takes the child Jesus in his arms in the temple and blesses God that his eyes have seen the Lord’s salvation.

story_title: Jesus Is Baptized to Fulfill All Righteousness
story_summary: Coming from Galilee to Jordan unto John, Jesus insists on being baptized to fulfill all righteousness, setting the covenant example as the Spirit descends and the Father’s voice is heard.

story_title: Jesus Overcomes Temptation in the Wilderness by the Word of God
story_summary: After fasting forty days and forty nights, Jesus answers every temptation of the adversary with scripture, showing unyielding fidelity to His Father.

story_title: Simon Peter Lets Down His Nets at the Master’s Word
story_summary: Having toiled all the night and taken nothing, Simon obeys Jesus’s command to launch out into the deep, encloses a miraculous multitude of fishes, and falls at Jesus’s knees to follow Him.

story_title: Jesus Cleanses the Leper Who Kneels Before Him
story_summary: Approaching the Savior on his knees with the plea, “Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean,” a leper feels the compassionate touch of Jesus’s hand and is immediately cleansed.

story_title: Four Friends Lower the Paralytic Through the Roof to Jesus
story_summary: Unable to come nigh unto Jesus because of the press, four men uncover the roof to lower their sick friend, and Jesus—seeing their faith—forgives his sins and commands him to walk.

story_title: Matthew Leaves the Receipt of Custom to Follow Christ
story_summary: Sitting at the tax collector’s booth, Matthew hears the Savior’s simple invitation, “Follow me,” arises to leave all behind, and welcomes sinners to hear the Physician of souls.

story_title: The Centurion’s Great Faith Heals His Servant from Afar
story_summary: Counting himself unworthy that the Lord should enter under his roof, a Roman centurion trusts that Jesus need only speak the word, moving the Savior to marvel at such faith.

story_title: The Penitent Woman Washes the Savior’s Feet with Her Tears
story_summary: Entering the Pharisee’s house with an alabaster box of ointment, a woman weeps at Jesus’s feet and wipes them with her hair, receiving forgiveness because she loved much and trusted in Him.

story_title: Jesus Stills the Tempest and Asks, “Where Is Your Faith?”
story_summary: Awakened by terrified disciples as waves fill their ship on the Sea of Galilee, Jesus rebukes the wind and the raging water into a great calm and calls His disciples to deeper faith.

story_title: Jairus Believes Only as Jesus Raises His Daughter
story_summary: When messengers report that his twelve-year-old daughter has died, Jairus clings to Jesus’s assurance, “Be not afraid, only believe,” and witnesses the Savior take her by the hand to arise.

story_title: The Woman with an Issue of Blood Touches Christ’s Garment
story_summary: Having spent all she had over twelve years of affliction, a woman reaches through the crowd in quiet faith to touch the Savior’s clothes and hears Him say, “Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole.”

story_title: Two Blind Men Cry After Jesus and Receive Their Sight
story_summary: Following Jesus into the house crying for mercy, two blind men answer “Yea, Lord” when asked if they believe He is able to heal them, and their eyes are opened according to their faith.

story_title: Peter Walks on the Water and Cries, “Lord, Save Me”
story_summary: Bidden by Jesus to come across the wind-tossed sea, Peter walks on the water until fear overtakes him, cries out for deliverance, and is immediately caught by the Savior’s outstretched hand.

story_title: Peter’s Testimony of the Living Christ at Caesarea Philippi
story_summary: When Jesus asks His disciples, “Whom say ye that I am?” Simon Peter testifies by revelation from the Father in heaven: “Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

story_title: “To Whom Shall We Go? Thou Hast the Words of Eternal Life”
story_summary: When many disciples walk no more with Jesus after the Bread of Life sermon, Peter speaks for the Twelve in steadfast loyalty, testifying that Jesus is that Christ, the Son of the living God.

story_title: The Canaanite Woman’s Persistent Faith Heals Her Daughter
story_summary: Undeterred by silence or testing, a woman of Canaan worships at Jesus’s feet pleading for even the crumbs from the Master’s table, and Jesus commends her great faith.

story_title: A Father Cries Out, “Lord, I Believe; Help Thou Mine Unbelief”
story_summary: Learning from Jesus that all things are possible to him that believeth, the father of an afflicted boy cries out with tears for help in his imperfect faith, and the Savior heals his child.

story_title: The Woman Taken in Adultery Is Forgiven and Commanded to Sin No More
story_summary: After her accusers depart convicted by their own consciences, Jesus lifts up the woman with tender mercy: “Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.”

story_title: The Man Born Blind Washes in the Pool of Siloam and Worships Jesus
story_summary: Anointed with clay by the Savior, a man blind from birth obeys the command to wash in Siloam, defends Jesus before the Pharisees, and worships Him when he learns He is the Son of God.

story_title: Martha Testifies of the Resurrection and the Life Before Lazarus Rises
story_summary: Weeping over her brother’s death, Martha meets Jesus on the road and declares her faith that He is the Christ, the Son of God, before witnessing Lazarus come forth from the tomb.

story_title: The One Grateful Leper Returns to Glorify God at Jesus’s Feet
story_summary: Of ten lepers cleansed as they went to show themselves to the priests, one—a Samaritan—turns back with a loud voice to fall at Jesus’s feet in thanksgiving, and his faith makes him whole.

story_title: The Parable of the Lost Sheep and Joy in Heaven Over Repentance
story_summary: Jesus teaches that a shepherd leaves the ninety and nine in the wilderness to seek the one sheep that is lost, rejoicing more over one sinner that repenteth.

story_title: The Prodigal Son Returns Home to His Father’s Embrace
story_summary: Having wasted his substance in riotous living, a younger son comes to himself, resolves to confess his sin, and is met down the road by his compassionate father’s embrace.

story_title: The Publican Beats Upon His Breast and Goes Down Justified
story_summary: Standing afar off in the temple without lifting his eyes to heaven, a humble publican pleads, “God be merciful to me a sinner,” and returns to his house justified rather than the proud Pharisee.

story_title: Blind Bartimaeus Casts Away His Garment and Follows Jesus
story_summary: Refusing to be silenced by the multitude outside Jericho, blind Bartimaeus cries out to the Son of David for mercy, receives his sight by faith, and follows Jesus in the way.

story_title: Zacchaeus Repents and Restores Fourfold in Jericho
story_summary: Honored when the Savior abides at his house, Zacchaeus stands before the Lord and pledges to give half his goods to the poor and restore fourfold to anyone he has wronged.

story_title: The Widow Casts All Her Living into the Temple Treasury
story_summary: Watching the rich cast gifts into the treasury, Jesus calls His disciples to witness a poor widow who in quiet covenant devotion casts in two mites, all the living that she had.

story_title: Jesus Institutes the Sacrament Covenant in the Upper Room
story_summary: On the night He is betrayed, the Savior blesses bread and wine as emblems of His body and blood shed for the remission of sins, inviting His disciples to remember Him always.

story_title: The Savior Submits to the Father’s Will in Gethsemane
story_summary: In agony in the Garden of Gethsemane as His sweat falls like great drops of blood, Jesus prays, “Not my will, but thine, be done,” fulfilling the great atoning sacrifice.

story_title: Peter Weeps Bitterly After the Lord Turns and Looks Upon Him
story_summary: After denying the Savior thrice in the courtyard, Peter sees the Lord turn and look upon him, remembers His word, and goes out to weep bitterly in sincere repentance.

story_title: The Penitent Thief on the Cross Asks Jesus to Remember Him
story_summary: Rebuking his fellow malefactor and confessing that they receive the due reward of their deeds while Jesus has done nothing amiss, the thief pleads in faith to be remembered in Christ’s kingdom.

story_title: Mary Magdalene Hears the Risen Lord Call Her by Name
story_summary: Standing weeping outside the empty sepulchre, Mary Magdalene turns at the Savior’s voice calling “Mary,” recognizes her risen Master, and runs to testify to the disciples.

story_title: Thomas Beholds the Risen Lord’s Wounds and Believes
story_summary: Invited by the resurrected Savior to reach hither his finger and behold His hands and side, Thomas casts aside all doubt and exclaims, “My Lord and my God.”

story_title: Peter Reaffirms His Love Thrice and Is Commissioned to Feed Christ’s Sheep
story_summary: Beside a fire of coals on the shore of Galilee, the risen Lord asks Simon Peter three times, “Lovest thou me?” restoring and commissioning him to feed His lambs and sheep.

story_title: Three Thousand Souls Are Pricked in Their Heart on Pentecost
story_summary: Hearing Peter’s bold witness of the crucified and risen Christ, the multitude asks what they shall do, and three thousand souls repent and enter the baptismal covenant that day.

story_title: Saul Repents on the Road to Damascus and Is Baptized
story_summary: Shined round about by a light from heaven, Saul asks the risen Lord, “What wilt thou have me to do?” fasts three days in Damascus, and arises to be baptized as a chosen vessel.

story_title: Noah Builds the Ark in Faith and Enters God’s Covenant
story_summary: Walking with God amid a corrupt generation, Noah obeys every command to build the ark and offers sacrifice on an altar as the Lord establishes His everlasting covenant in the cloud.

story_title: Abraham Trusts the Lord on Mount Moriah
story_summary: Tested in the ultimate trial of faith, Abraham journeys to Moriah trusting that God will provide Himself a lamb, and the Lord renews His covenant to bless all nations through Abraham’s seed.

story_title: Joseph Refuses Potiphar’s Wife to Keep His Integrity Before God
story_summary: Tempted daily in Egypt, Joseph refuses to sin against God, enduring false imprisonment with unshaken faithfulness as the Lord remains with him and prospers all he does.

story_title: Joseph Forgives His Repentant Brothers in Egypt
story_summary: After Judah offers himself as a bondman in Benjamin’s stead, Joseph weeps aloud and reveals himself to his brothers, testifying that God sent him before them to preserve life.

story_title: Moses Stretches Out His Hand at the Red Sea
story_summary: Trapped between Pharaoh’s chariots and the sea, Moses calls Israel to stand still and see the salvation of the Lord, stretching out his hand in faith as the waters divide.

story_title: Israel Looks Upon the Brazen Serpent and Lives
story_summary: Bitten by fiery serpents in the wilderness, the people confess their sin and look in faith toward the serpent of brass raised by Moses upon a pole, receiving life and healing.

story_title: Joshua and Israel Covenant to Serve the Lord at Shechem
story_summary: Gathering all the tribes of Israel at Shechem, Joshua recounts the Lord’s deliverances and declares, “As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord,” as the people renew their covenant.

story_title: Ruth Cleaves to Naomi and the God of Israel
story_summary: Forsaking her homeland out of love and devotion, Ruth pledges to Naomi, “Thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God,” coming to trust under the wings of the Lord.

story_title: Hannah Pours Out Her Soul in Prayer at the Temple in Shiloh
story_summary: Weeping in bitterness of soul, Hannah vows a covenant vow unto the Lord of hosts, receives peace through Eli’s blessing, and dedicates her son Samuel to the Lord all the days of his life.

story_title: David Faces Goliath in the Name of the Lord of Hosts
story_summary: Remembering how the Lord delivered him from the paw of the lion and the bear, young David steps onto the battlefield armed with faith in the living God of Israel.

story_title: Naaman Washes Seven Times in the River Jordan
story_summary: Persuaded by his servants to humble himself and obey Elisha’s simple command, Naaman dips seven times in the Jordan and his flesh is restored like that of a little child.

story_title: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego Stand True Before the Fiery Furnace
story_summary: Refusing to bow to Nebuchadnezzar’s golden image, three Hebrew youths declare their trust in God—and even if He does not deliver them, they will not break their covenant—and walk unharmed with the Son of God.

story_title: Daniel Prays Faithfully and Is Delivered from the Lions’ Den
story_summary: Continuing to kneel in prayer three times a day despite the royal decree, Daniel is preserved unharmed in the den of lions because he believed in his God.

story_title: Joseph Smith Repents After the Loss of the 116 Pages
story_summary: After losing the manuscript pages by yielding to the persuasions of men, Joseph Smith humbles himself in anguish and is assured that God is merciful and that he is still chosen.

story_title: The Lord Speaks Peace to Oliver Cowdery’s Mind
story_summary: Seeking a witness of the Restoration, Oliver Cowdery is reminded by the Lord of the night he cried unto Him in his heart and received peace as a witness of the truth.

story_title: The Savior Testifies of His Atoning Suffering to Martin Harris
story_summary: Calling Martin Harris to repent and keep His commandments, Jesus Christ describes His suffering in Gethsemane and on the cross so that all who repent might not suffer.

story_title: The Promise of Complete Forgiveness to Those Who Confess and Forsake
story_summary: Instructing early Saints returning from Missouri, the Lord declares that he who has repented of his sins is forgiven and the Lord remembers them no more.

story_title: The Risen Savior Accepts the Kirtland Temple
story_summary: Standing upon the breastwork of the pulpit in Kirtland, the Lord appears in glory to Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery, proclaiming that He is the Advocate with the Father and accepting His house.

story_title: The Lord Speaks Peace to Joseph Smith in Liberty Jail
story_summary: Crying unto God from a freezing dungeon in Missouri, Joseph Smith receives the Lord’s tender assurance that his adversity shall be but a small moment and shall be consecrated for his good.

story_title: Adam and Eve Offer Sacrifice in Faith and Rejoice in Redemption
story_summary: Obeying the Lord’s command to offer sacrifices before knowing why, Adam and Eve learn from an angel that all things are a similitude of the Only Begotten and bless the name of God.

story_title: Enoch Walks with God and Preaches Repentance to Build Zion
story_summary: Feeling slow of speech when called to cry repentance, Enoch trusts the Lord’s promise to abide with him, leading his people to become of one heart and one mind in righteousness.

story_title: Abraham Is Delivered on the Altar and Receives the Covenant
story_summary: Bound upon the priest’s altar in Chaldea for refusing to worship idols, Abraham lifts his voice to the Almighty, is delivered by the angel of His presence, and receives the covenant of the priesthood.

story_title: Joseph Smith Kneels in Faith in the Sacred Grove
story_summary: Trusting the promise of James 1:5 that God gives wisdom liberally, young Joseph Smith kneels in vocal prayer, is delivered from unseen darkness, and beholds the Father and the Son.
